question: Do the four E001X phase trajectories that failed the last-ten-time-unit stationarity test at T100 pass the same numerical tolerances at T500, or after a conditional extension to T1000?
authorization: Prepared on GitHub by user instruction; no queue request has been issued. User authorizes actual run separately.
extension_policy: Each trajectory runs from saved T100 to T500. If it fails any stationarity criterion, continue that same trajectory to T1000. Stop there even if it still fails. Preserve every result.

stationarity.logic: All three must pass; same tolerances as E001X. These are finite-window diagnostics, not proof of unique steady state.

observables.added: Per-edge B_L, B_R, M_L, E_L; their sums; oriented hop/form/idle/total node currents; sink inflows; full dn_i/dt; own-channel contributions to B_L from node dephasing, edge dephasing, break and idle.
observables.transport_distinction: formation_currentXX is link conversion R<->L; I_formXX is node transfer.
observables.ledger: integral F = integral I_hop+integral I_form+integral I_idle+n2(start)-n2(end); integrals are signed.

retention.full_data_access: Only by separate explicit user instruction; task reads only the four pinned input checkpoints.

CONT.source: Neighbor forecast supplied by user before CONT
CONT.caveat: Linearity establishes phase-average identity, not decay of all deviations. PP/PQ are not continued here; this run cannot establish four-variant ranking at a common T500 or T1000.

SQRT.caveat: Future unlaunched experiment. Equal B_L and M_L matches Pi/S instantaneous idle event rates on a fixed state, not full generators or final flux.

J0.QP: Positive stationary flux is a prediction, not guaranteed here; idle transport needs PL>0.
J0.PP_above_008: Interpretation trigger proposed by neighbor; not an acceptance threshold.

interpretation_limits: No E002 damage or repair test.
Do not promote forecast failures to numerical failures or call them discoveries without further analysis.
Mixture comparison uses saved T100 reference, not an evolved mixture.
No claim of full steady-state uniqueness, quantum advantage, autopoiesis, BIC or cosmological dark sector.
No partition of unsigned physical provenance: node currents and integrated ledger entries may be negative.
Same-state rate equality is weaker than generator equivalence.
